title: Probability of a satisfied DNF term
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on a finite sign cube, with no coordinate appearing more than once, and let its width be the number of literals. Under the uniform distribution on the sign cube, the probability that $T$ evaluates to $-1$ is $2^{-\mathrm{width}(T)}$.
